function: AES S-box (FIPS 197): inversion in GF(2^8) mod x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1, then the affine map with constant 0x63
bit_order: U0 and S0 are the most significant bits (msb/msb), as in NIST's files

nist.compared_with: every forward AES S-box circuit of the pin (104): aes-sbox/, sbox/, old-2020/
nist.pareto_points_note: NIST's Pareto points in (A, AD, G, GD) among the 104 (33 points) that this circuit matches or beats in all four and beats in at least one

checker: circuits/check.py (boolcirc) as at commit 08012e1; search/nonlinear/boolflux/aes_check.py as at commit 08012e1 (BoolFlux core and independent/verify.py, NIST's 104 forward circuits); and a third evaluator (the table computed from GF(2^8) and the affine map of FIPS 197, written for this check)
